attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs (T1562.008)
attackers_goals: Avoiding detection of their activities by limiting the amount of data collected. This action may be preliminary to resource deletion or data exhilaration from the resource. Setting the stage for further attacks, like a Ransomware Attack.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Disaster Recovery Risks, Cloud Data Asset Protection Tampering, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Confirm that the identity intended to disable logging on this resource. Follow further actions done by the identity. Monitor other (non-disabled) activity logs related to this resource.
